title: Origin story: Runecarver
description: Runecarver was a mason who cut runes into cornerstones, and discovered that carved words hold: a carved blessing protects, a carved curse binds, a carved name remembers. She carves the true names of things into the world's foundations, and the world, reading them, behaves accordingly.

title: Ability profile: Runecarver
description: Ranked abilities: Rune carving — rank 100/100; Precision — rank 99/100; True naming — rank 98/100; Stone lore — rank 97/100; Patience — rank 96/100.

title: Power ranking: Runecarver
description: Powers: Carved words hold true; Her runes bind and bless; Stone remembers her carving.

title: Stamina feats: Runecarver
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Carved for sixty years; Cut the great warding in a single winter.

title: Crossover notes: Runecarver
description: Runecarver crosses naturally with: runes, stone, the carved word.
